issues.description: Fixed an intermittent issue where connections to the URL cloud went down due to a failure to resolve DNS.
Fixed an issue where wificlient in PAN-OS 10.0 and later releases caused processing delays, on-chip descriptor spikes, and buffer usage.
Fixed an issue where a sudden increase in URL data approached the maximum cache capacity of the firewall.
Fixed an intermittent issue where websites were blocked and categorized as not resolved.
